youtube.title: Abhimanyu Chakravyuh se bahar kyun nahi aa paya? 🏹 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Mahabharata ke yudh mein Arjun ke veer putra Abhimanyu ne Chakravyuh mein pravesh kiya. Kaha jata hai ki jab wo Subhadra ke garbh mein the, tab Arjun ne Subhadra ko Chakravyuh todne ka tarika sunaya tha. Pravesh ka gyan sunkar wo gyan Abhimanyu tak pahunch gaya, lekin Subhadra ko neend aa gayi aur nikalne ka tarika adhura reh gaya.

Dronacharya ne yudh ke terahve din Chakravyuh rachi. Arjun ko door le jaya gaya, aur Abhimanyu ne Pandavon ke liye raasta banane ka bida uthaya. Wo akela andar gaya aur veerta se ladta raha, par bahar nikalne ka marg na jaanne ke karan ghir gaya aur veergati ko prapt hua.

Katha ka strot: Mahabharata, Drona Parva, prachalit katha.
